message.reasoning_content: We need to determine criminal liability under Chinese law. Facts: illegal discharge of waste water containing heavy metals exceeding standards. Likely crime of "非法排放污染物罪" under the Environmental Protection Law and Criminal Law article 338? Actually Chinese Criminal Law article 338: "违反国家规定，非法倾倒、排放、处置危险废物或者其他有毒有害物质，造成严重后果的，处五年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处五年以上有期徒刑。" Also article 338 for "非法排放污染物" maybe article 338 (2). Also article 338 (1) for "非法排放、倾倒、处置危险废物或者其他有毒有害物质". The waste water contains heavy metals, likely considered "有毒有害物质". The discharge caused pollution, exceeding standards. The case likely charged with "非法排放污染物罪". So answer: [罪名]非法排放污染物罪<eoa>
